statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold while the approaching U.S. data/open cluster and quarterly expiration keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Current conditions remain a WATCH state; any escalation depends on observed post-release or cash-open persistence rather than scheduled events alone.
headline: WATCH ahead of U.S. data and expiration cluster
body: Nasdaq-100 futures remain positive in current delayed data but have retraced from the reported session high. Fresh Finviz breadth and semiconductor context is supportive but non-real-time, while oil is lower. Granular live NQ pullback quality remains incomplete, so Tail stays below the blocking threshold as event and expiration risk lifts Stress.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 hours, Tail moved between low, WATCH and brief orange states as Thursday's trend-up path strengthened and then normalized overnight. Tail peaked at 26 before returning to low/WATCH readings ahead of Friday's data and expiration cluster.
outlookSummary: Risk is concentrated from 13:00-14:30 UTC around Industrial Production, the cash open/Bowman remarks, State Employment and LEI. Tail stays below a block unless observed post-event structure becomes persistently one-way; expiration can keep Stress high into the close, followed by sharply lower active path risk during the weekend closure.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ remains positive but has pulled back from the reported session high, while fresh breadth and semiconductor context is supportive but non-real-time. Granular retracement quality is incomplete, so Tail stays WATCH as the U.S. data/open cluster approaches.
